Campaigns that influenced pipeline or revenue in the period.LinkedIn campaigns that influenced pipe or revenue in-period. Pipe = Fibbler open + closed-lost; revenue = closed-won. Campaign buckets (Enterprise, Upmarket, Strategic, Remarketing, Competitive Takeout, Thought Leadership) sit above the campaign list. 15 per page (or Show all). Expand a row for top 10 companies by revenue, then pipe. Names cleaned; type and Remarketing/Awareness badges replace raw format.

Page 1

Methodology: campaign-level influence, which can double count.Methodology: Fibbler campaign-level influence; pipe and revenue can double-count across campaigns (a deal may appear under every campaign that touched it). Same period windows as the rest of this page. LinkedIn only. Company drilldown is top 10 by influenced revenue, then pipeline, among cohort deals that campaign touched in-period.

Things to Know

  • Demo data. Hooli is a fictional company. Every account, deal, campaign, and number on this page is made up for demonstration.
  • Cohort. New Business deals with 3+ LinkedIn paid clicks at the company. Time Frame switches the window; rules stay the same.
  • Create vs close. Pipeline and journeys use create date. Influenced revenue uses close date (Closed Won only). Deal lists (deal table, campaign-by-deal, campaign buckets) show open and lost deals by create date and Closed Won deals by close date, so a deal won in the period is listed even if it was created earlier. Each deal appears once per period.
  • Spend. All spend is LinkedIn account spend in-window (Sep is MTD), split by campaign from LinkedIn's own delivery data. Campaign rows, buckets, and the overview KPI therefore reconcile to the same LinkedIn total. YTD account spend $121,909.
  • Cost per opp. Period account ad spend divided by influenced opportunities created in the period (any stage, same 3+ paid click cohort; New Business combined per company). Without partnerships divides the same spend by non-partner opportunities created.
  • Period comparison. Last full month compares to the month before, Last 3 months to the 3 months before, and Month to date to the same days of the prior month (deals, pipeline, and revenue only; daily spend for the prior month is not on file, so Ad spend and Cost per opp show no comparison in Month to date). YTD has no comparison because prior-year deal data is not in this pull. Prior-period deals use their current stage. Green is favorable, red unfavorable, grey neutral (spend).
  • What changed. What changed is generated from the same numbers: the two biggest movers vs the prior period, the buckets with the most bucket pipeline, and buckets with spend but $0 bucket pipeline. YTD has no comparison.
  • Deal outcomes. Click depth uses cohort deals that closed won or lost in the period by close date; win rate = won / (won + lost). Time to opp uses Fibbler's days from the first recorded LinkedIn ad impression to opp create (and to close for wins), from the deal pull on file; LinkedIn data in Fibbler starts in December 2024, so older first touches are capped there. The Dreamdata 212 to 281 day figure is an external benchmark measured to revenue, not opp creation.
  • Shared links. The address bar keeps the period, partnerships switch, deal table filters and sort, campaign breakdown filters, open bucket, campaign list toggle, and journey view, so a copied link opens the same view.
  • Pipeline vs revenue. Open pipeline = any stage that is not Closed Won, Closed Lost, or Disqualified. Revenue = Closed Won closed in-period.
  • Partial month. September 2026 is partial (Fibbler data as of Sep 18 ET; 18 of 30 days). Last 3 months = Jun to Aug 2026 full months; last full month = August 2026.
  • Partnerships switch. With / Without at the top recomputes overview KPIs, charts, deal tables, campaign-by-deal cards, journeys, and campaign buckets. Fibbler campaign-level totals in the campaign list, summary, and ad type / remarketing efficiency cannot be split by deal and stay the same; Efficiency by campaign bucket follows the buckets.
  • Partnership. Partnership accounts come from the Hooli CRM partnership company list (146 companies). 22 of 377 influenced companies (24 deals) match by company name after normalizing case, punctuation, and legal suffixes. They carry a Partnership tag, and the Without partnership deals overview removes them. Ad spend is the same in both views.
  • Journeys. When present, cards show 12 months of paid activity ending on create. Est. Spend uses Aug+Sep 2026 blended CPM/CPC (not booked spend).
  • Campaign buckets. Enterprise, Upmarket, Strategic, Remarketing, Competitive Takeout, and Thought Leadership roll up campaigns by name. Spend, impressions, and clicks cover every bucket campaign in the period. Pipeline and revenue count each cohort deal once per bucket (a deal touched by several Enterprise campaigns counts once); a deal touched by two buckets shows in both. Thought Leadership matches campaigns whose name contains TL or Thought Leadership, so a campaign can belong to more than one bucket (for example an Upmarket TL & Single Image campaign counts in both Upmarket and Thought Leadership). Deals without Fibbler campaign touchpoints cannot be bucketed, so bucket pipeline and revenue are floors.
  • Campaign performance. Ad type and remarketing vs awareness mix and efficiency are campaign-level; pipe/rev can double-count across campaigns. Spotlight is out of ad-type charts. Efficiency by campaign bucket uses the same six buckets and the same spend, pipeline, and revenue as the Campaign buckets cards, plus a Not in a bucket row for campaigns that match no bucket (for example Spotlight and Customers). Efficiency rows sort by pipeline, and rows with $0 pipeline and $0 revenue are greyed out.
